# Parley v0.1.25

This test beta adds explicit deletion of saved context and makes Clear History
remove the stored copies of context, returned files and finished command
results that previously remained behind.

## Delete saved context

- Delete Saved Context is available in the Context menu and Status Center.
  Delete one editable draft, all eligible records in the selected scope, or
  a returned-file copy from its handoff.
- Deletion removes captured text, delivery edits and the separate original
  returned-file copy from Parley's storage and running app state. Discard
  continues to remove a draft from the review queue while retaining evidence.
- Deletion checks the revisions shown before removing any selected record.
  A draft that changed, became a waiting approval or is being delivered is
  protected. Storage failures are reported rather than described as success.

## Clear history and closed workspaces

- Clear History also removes eligible saved context and returned-file copies
  in its scope, including records hidden by search filters or dismissal.
- Finished command results are removed from the recovery cache as well as
  history. Worker files receive a fresh check before deletion. Only request
  identity hashes remain in memory to prevent an old command retry from
  becoming executable again; command and result text are removed.
- Waiting approvals, deliveries in progress and running command workers remain
  protected. Clearing records does not stop running panes.
- Closed workspaces with retained records remain selectable in Status Center.
  The close dialog explains that closing ends pane processes and retains
  history and saved context until they are explicitly cleared.
- New agent context records retain their source workspace identity. Older
  records use their recorded handoff links where available; old context with
  no workspace association can be deleted through All Workspaces or Delete
  Saved Context.

Original project files, exports and messages already received by vendor CLIs
are unchanged by these deletion actions.

Agent protocol remains at version 28.

Unnotarized test beta: ad-hoc signed without the hardened runtime, not
notarized, no automatic updates. Install only from the expected GitLab
release after checking SHA256SUMS.
